family_invitations_single_terminal_state.name: family_invitations_single_terminal_state
family_invitations_single_terminal_state.value: not ("family_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "family_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

family_memories_title_length.name: family_memories_title_length
family_memories_title_length.value: "family_memories"."title" is null or char_length("family_memories"."title") between 1 and 120

family_polls_description_length.name: family_polls_description_length
family_polls_description_length.value: "family_polls"."description" is null or (char_length("family_polls"."description") between 1 and 1000 and "family_polls"."description" = btrim("family_polls"."description"))

family_time_capsules_message_length.name: family_time_capsules_message_length
family_time_capsules_message_length.value: "family_time_capsules"."message" is null or (char_length("family_time_capsules"."message") between 1 and 5000 and "family_time_capsules"."message" = btrim("family_time_capsules"."message"))

households_description_length.name: households_description_length
households_description_length.value: "households"."description" is null or (char_length("households"."description") between 1 and 500 and "households"."description" = btrim("households"."description"))
